description: Implementation of ICMP protocol functions for IPv4 and IPv6, including sending echo requests, handling ICMP messages, and managing ICMP contexts and offload handlers within the Zephyr RTOS network stack.

methods.name: net_icmp_init_ctx
methods.description: Initializes an ICMP context with specified type, code, and handler, and registers it.

methods.name: net_icmp_cleanup_ctx
methods.description: Removes an ICMP context from registration and clears associated resources.

methods.name: net_icmp_send_echo_request
methods.description: Sends an ICMP echo request (ping) over IPv4 or IPv6, depending on address family, using the specified context and interface.

methods.name: net_icmp_register_offload_ping
methods.description: Registers an offload ping handler for a specific network interface.

methods.name: net_icmp_unregister_offload_ping
methods.description: Unregisters an offload ping handler from a network interface.

methods.name: net_icmp_get_offload_rsp_handler
methods.description: Retrieves the response handler associated with an offloaded ICMP ping.

methods.name: net_icmp_call_ipv4_handlers
methods.description: Invokes registered ICMP handlers for an IPv4 packet.

methods.name: net_icmp_call_ipv6_handlers
methods.description: Invokes registered ICMP handlers for an IPv6 packet.
